Later, media controls and notification cards may need a separate notification listener grant in Android Settings. You can choose whether to enable it.
Selecting favorites may use the system picker. Direct calls would need a separate permission and confirmation; the system dialer remains the default.
A future tap-to-talk assistant would ask for microphone access when used. This version does not listen.
